reason: Research was thin: WebSearch ran three times and returned mostly stale results (2018 to 2024 pages and a May 2026 recap). I could not confirm the 2026-10-09 closes or a current week-ahead outlook, so this decision rests mainly on the packet. The most recent macro data I found was from about 2026-10-02: the 10-year yield settled near 5.28% after touching 5.34%, the highest since 2002. That is a real headwind for rate-sensitive legs such as SPLV and XLV, but it is not enough by itself to justify a full replacement. The book is -1.23% with 95% gross in XLF, XLE, SPY, XLV, BTC and SPLV, all still above entry except BTC (which is up on mark). No stop or take-profit has fired, and every stop is well away from its mark. Churning the whole $1,000 book on unverified prices would cost frictions and add execution risk without a confirmed edge. I will reassess next week once current closes are available.
